==Hallowed Preparations==
{{Checklist|
* Talk to [[Efaritay]], then leave the palace and pick [[amitire leaves]] from the [[amitire plant]] east of the entrance.
* Return to the palace. Search the shelves next to the sink (south of Efaritay) for a bowl. Fill it with water.
* Search the cupboard by the western wall for a [[potato]] and [[raw impaler meat]].
* Use the bowl of water on the potato.
* Cook the impaler meat at the range, then use the incomplete stew on the cooked meat.
* Cook the stew, then use the leaves on it to create an [[amitire stew]].
* Talk to Efaritay, then use the stew on Safalaan.
* Talk to Efaritay again until you receive some [[Hallowed marks (The Blood Moon Rises)|hallowed marks]].
* Free up seven inventory spaces, then head to the east side of the palace.
* Talk to Ivan or [[Sarei]].
* Take all three tools from the workbench.
* Search the nearby crates for [[blisterwood logs]] and a [[blessed silver sickle]].
* Search the chests in the room for a [[diamond]] and an [[enchant diamond]] tablet.
* Use the items on the sickle in the following order: diamond, tablet, logs.
* Create the [[hallowed flail]] at the anvil. The blisterwood flail must be present in the inventory.
*Using a knife on [[blisterwood logs]] create blisterwood stakes
* Make your way downstairs, then talk to Veliaf and Vanescula. Talk with Veliaf again.
* Go back upstairs and talk to Sugadinti Vitur
* Gear up. Take ~15 [[rancid slimy potion]]s, ~5 [[foul chunky potion]]s, and 1 [[rank frothy potion]] from the supplies table in the base. Combination foods can be helpful, but it can just be easier to spam rancid slimy potions since they do not deplete your stats significantly. 
* Go outside to the bridge to start the defence section.
}}
